# Zach Ellerbrook

> Zach Ellerbrook works on small security projects and writes up what breaks along the way. In the Navy he is the IT service technician and security manager liaison for Navy Band Great Lakes, where he handles first-line IT support, reviews system authorization and SharePoint permission requests, reviews SAAR forms before they reach the security managers, and tracks clearance expirations. He is moving into a career in cybersecurity.

Clearance: Secret, renewed January 2023.
Location: Chicago area from mid-2027.
Contact: zach@zachellerbrook.com

## Focus

- Linux, Python, and log analysis
- Small security projects, built and documented in public

## Projects

- [ssh-detect-respond](https://zachellerbrook.com/work/ssh-detect-respond): SSH brute-force detection and response tooling in Python. Milestones 1 and 2 done. Source: https://github.com/zellerbrook/ssh-detect-respond
